Small, tested functions for the calculations in the personal finance
field manual: budgeting, savings, emergency funds, debt payoff, loans
and mortgages, investing, retirement accounts, insurance, and federal
income taxes.

# Package index

## Foundations

### Income

- [`fixed_cost_ratio()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/fixed_cost_ratio.md)
  : Fixed costs as a percent of take home pay
- [`raise_invested_value()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/raise_invested_value.md)
  : Future value of investing part of a raise
- [`wealth_formula()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/wealth_formula.md)
  : Wealth from saving part of an income every year

### Tracking spending

- [`apply_rules()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/apply_rules.md)
  : Categorize transactions with keyword rules
- [`subscription_opportunity_cost()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/subscription_opportunity_cost.md)
  : What a subscription would grow to if invested instead

### Budgeting

- [`months_to_break_even()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/months_to_break_even.md)
  : Months until an upfront cost pays for itself
- [`opportunity_cost()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/opportunity_cost.md)
  : What money spent today could grow to
- [`percent_of_income()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/percent_of_income.md)
  : Expense as a percent of income
- [`to_annual()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/to_annual.md)
  : Convert a daily, weekly, or monthly amount to a yearly amount
- [`to_monthly()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/to_monthly.md)
  : Convert a daily, weekly, or yearly amount to a monthly amount

### Managing debt

- [`apr_to_apy()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/apr_to_apy.md)
  : Convert an APR to an APY
- [`credit_utilization()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/credit_utilization.md)
  : Credit utilization
- [`dti_ratio()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/dti_ratio.md)
  : Debt to income (DTI) ratio
- [`idr_monthly_payment()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/idr_monthly_payment.md)
  : Income driven repayment (IDR) monthly payment
- [`loan_income_ratio()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/loan_income_ratio.md)
  : Student loan total relative to expected salary
- [`monthly_standard_payment()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/monthly_standard_payment.md)
  : Monthly payment on a standard student loan plan
- [`months_to_payoff()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/months_to_payoff.md)
  : Months to pay off a balance with a fixed payment
- [`order_avalanche()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/order_avalanche.md)
  : Order debts for the avalanche method
- [`order_snowball()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/order_snowball.md)
  : Order debts for the snowball method
- [`payoff_vs_invest()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/payoff_vs_invest.md)
  : Pay off a loan or invest the difference
- [`total_interest()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/total_interest.md)
  : Total interest paid over a loan

### Emergency fund

- [`ef_growth()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/ef_growth.md)
  : Emergency fund balance after interest
- [`emergency_fund_target()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/emergency_fund_target.md)
  : Emergency fund target
- [`monthly_contribution_needed()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/monthly_contribution_needed.md)
  : Monthly contribution needed to reach a target by a deadline
- [`months_to_ef_goal()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/months_to_ef_goal.md)
  : Months to reach an emergency fund target

## Savings

### Savings strategies

- [`savings_rate()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/savings_rate.md)
  : Savings rate

### High yield accounts

- [`hysa_balance()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/hysa_balance.md)
  : High yield savings account balance

### Automating savings

- [`monthly_savings()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/monthly_savings.md)
  : Monthly savings at a given savings rate

## Investing

### Investing basics

- [`future_value()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/future_value.md)
  : Future value of a one time investment
- [`future_value_series()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/future_value_series.md)
  : Future value of a series of equal contributions
- [`real_return()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/real_return.md)
  : Return after inflation
- [`rule_of_72()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/rule_of_72.md)
  : Years for money to double (rule of 72)

### Retirement accounts

- [`after_tax_value()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/after_tax_value.md)
  : After tax value of a retirement contribution
- [`employer_match()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/employer_match.md)
  : Yearly employer retirement match

### Index funds

- [`future_value_after_fees()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/future_value_after_fees.md)
  : Future value of monthly contributions after fund fees
- [`yearly_fee()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/yearly_fee.md)
  : Yearly fund fee

### Asset allocation

- [`portfolio_return()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/portfolio_return.md)
  : Blended return of a stock and bond portfolio
- [`rebalance_amount()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/rebalance_amount.md)
  : Amount to move to get back to a target allocation

## Taxes and insurance

### Taxes

- [`income_tax()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/income_tax.md)
  : Federal income tax for a single filer
- [`raise_kept()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/raise_kept.md)
  : Part of a raise kept after federal income tax

### Insurance

- [`break_even_years()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/break_even_years.md)
  : Years for a higher deductible to pay off
- [`plan_cost()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/plan_cost.md)
  : Total yearly cost of a health plan

## Planning

### Financial goals

- [`monthly_for_goal()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/monthly_for_goal.md)
  : Monthly deposit needed to reach a savings goal
- [`months_to_fund()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/months_to_fund.md)
  : Months to fund a goal with a fixed monthly amount

### Major purchases

- [`first_payment_split()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/first_payment_split.md)
  : Interest and principal in the first loan payment
- [`mortgage_payment()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/mortgage_payment.md)
  : Monthly payment on a fixed rate loan
- [`rent_buy_threshold()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/rent_buy_threshold.md)
  : Monthly rent that matches the unrecoverable cost of owning

### Estate planning

- [`beneficiary_share()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/beneficiary_share.md)
  : Share of assets with a named beneficiary
- [`net_worth()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinr/reference/net_worth.md)
  : Net worth
